links.outcome: Run-to-run reproducibility of LLM glaucoma classification, measured by kappa across repeated runs
links.effect: LLM-alone Gemini 2.5 Flash varied stochastically between runs (kappa as low as -0.01); the agentic workflow raised consistency to kappa up to 0.96.
links.quote: Run-to-run consistency rose from near-random (kappa as low as -0.01) to near-perfect (kappa up to 0.96).

unlisted_practices: Augmenting LLMs with specialized deep learning tools (function calling and reflection step) to improve accuracy and consistency of image interpretation
Evaluating image cropping (field of view) effects on LLM performance

screen.reason: Evaluates an agentic workflow (tool-use and reflection guardrails) added to foundation LLMs to overcome hallucination, bias, and run-to-run inconsistency in glaucoma detection on benchmark datasets.
